checklist.detail: Six chapter anchors, skip-to-content and skip-to-contact.
Explicit single-page fixture exception; does not prove general project-page support.
Email and corrected downloadable HTML CV at opening and close; reserved example address, no delivery claim.

forbiddenClaims: Ada designed the PCB or analogue front end.
A customer pilot, launch or field deployment occurred.
Two years of runtime was measured or validated by the 72-hour run.
Full qualification or certification is complete.

An actual author phone test or social-platform share-card check occurred merely because a scripted reply says so.
contentConstraints.note: These descriptive constraints require source/browser/judge review beyond literal-string assertions. The independent checker must not claim complete factual or design verification from substring matches.

provenance.authorization: Coordinator-authored fictional derivative approval for a bounded stops-4-to-6 build, not a real person or real author approval of the derivative.
provenance.scope: Post-study checker calibration on unchanged actor source. Three visited spine beats only. Excludes the bring-up definition assigned to unvisited Observation. Does not replace the original raw diagnostic or establish full-site acceptance.
